saints.name: St. Lawrence O'Toole
saints.title: Bishop
saints.shortBlurb: The reforming Archbishop of Dublin who shepherded his people through the Norman conquest of Ireland…
biography: Born about 1128, Lorcán Ua Tuathail was abbot of Glendalough before he was chosen Archbishop of Dublin in 1162. A reformer and a friend of the poor, he laboured to renew the discipline of clergy and people and was noted for his personal austerity and charity.

He guided Dublin through the turmoil of the Anglo-Norman invasion, acting as mediator between the Irish and the newcomers, and took part in the Third Lateran Council in 1179. He died at Eu in Normandy on 14 November 1180 while on an embassy of peace. He is the patron saint of the Archdiocese of Dublin.
saints.knownFor: Reform of the Church and peacemaking during the Norman invasion.
